choices.reason: Both candidates measure the same preregistered H2a contrast, without a distinct primary-metric designation in the paper. LUAR-MUD is the paper's selected specification for its main-text analyses; CISR repeats H1/H2 with an alternative embedding model.
choices.locator: PDF pp. 14 and 16, Appendix B.2, Style Embedding Model Selection (the sentence begins with LUAR-MUD at the end of p. 14 and continues below Table 3 on p. 16); see also p. 5, section 5.2, and p. 6, section 6.2.
choices.quote: LUAR-MUD performs best on this proxy task, so we use this model’s embeddings for the rest of our analysis. We also repeat our analysis for H1 and H2 using CISR.
